meta.description: Injured in a car accident in the U.S.? I'm Larissa Ribeiro, a paralegal at Berman Law Group. I assist clients in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

hero.headlineMain: has been injured in a car accident,
hero.intro: I assist clients across the United States and will do my best to guide you through the process.

how.title: How I can help
how.intro: One step at a time, at your pace.

contact.title: You reach out
contact.text: Message me on WhatsApp, call, or send an email and tell me what happened, at your own pace.

guidance.title: I listen and guide
guidance.text: I explain how the process usually works and which information and documents are worth gathering.

referral.title: I refer you to an attorney
referral.text: When your case needs an attorney, I refer you to the attorneys at Berman Law Group.

followUp.title: I stay by your side
followUp.text: I stay available to answer questions and keep in touch through the next stages.

about.title: About Larissa
about.lead: I'm Larissa Ribeiro, a paralegal (non attorney) at Berman Law Group. My job is to welcome people who were hurt in a car accident and explain, in plain language, where to start.
about.closing: I speak your language, and I know a moment like this can be confusing. I'm here to listen and guide you, with no rush.
